analysis.primary_measure: unconditional P1 wins divided by all validated games

rules.consistent: at least two material contrasts have the same sign and none has the opposite material sign, or all three contrasts are within the practical-equivalence margin
rules.non-monotonic: at least one contrast is greater than +margin and at least one is less than -margin
rules.search-dependent: three valid estimates exist and neither non-monotonic nor consistent applies
rules.unresolved: defensive fallback after all other rules
rules.unresolved-invalid: required input, validation, or estimate is missing or invalid

difference_in_differences.resampling: independently resample all four board-budget game samples in every replicate

secondary.late_reversal_denominator: games with a non-tied checkpoint leader and a non-draw final result
